cards.audioText: B: [You’re the pilot of CES5325, which is bound for Wuhan. You’ve just been handed over from Hefei Control. You’re over IKUBA at 23, and your level is at 8400m, call Wuhan Control.]
cards.audioTextZh: B：【你是东方5325的飞行员，目的地武汉。你刚刚从合肥区调交接过来。你23分过IKUBA，高度8400米，呼叫武汉区调。】
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Control, CES5325, over IKUBA at 23, maintain 8400m.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉区调，南方5325，23分过IKUBA，正保持8400米。

cards.audioText: C: CES5325, radar identified, descend to and maintain 6000m, report reaching.
cards.audioTextZh: C：东方5325，雷达看见了，下6000米保持，到达后报。
cards.referenceText: Descend to and maintain 6000m, wilco, CES5325.

cards.audioText: B: [You’ve just followed your TCAS RA instruction. You’ve stopped your descent at nearly 6800m, and track out 9km right of the course, report to ATC.]
cards.audioTextZh: B：【你已执行了TCAS RA指令。你已停止下降，高度维持在约6800米，并偏航右转偏离原航线9公里，现向空管报告。】
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Control, CES5325, our TCAS instructed us to stop descent at 6800m, and we are tracking out 9km right of the course.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉区调，东方5325，TCAS指示我们在6800米停止下降，我们偏航右转偏离原航线9公里。

cards.audioText: C: Roger, CES5325, you’ve just passed the traffic, descend to 6000m and turn left heading 170 immediately, there is military activity in the area right now.
cards.audioTextZh: C：收到，东方5325，你刚刚过冲突航空器，立刻下6000米并左转航向170，该区域目前有军事活动。
cards.referenceText: Roger, descend to 6000m and turn left heading 170 immediately, CES5325.
cards.referenceTextZh: 收到，立刻下6000米并左转航向170，东方5325。

cards.audioText: B: [You hear a loud bang, it seems that the left wing has been hit by something, and you feel the airplane has banking tendency. Declare Urgency to ATC and request priority landing and emergency services.]
cards.audioTextZh: B：【你听到一声巨响，左侧机翼似乎被异物击中，且飞机出现倾斜趋势。立即向空管通报紧急情况，请求优先着陆及地面应急服务待命。】
cards.referenceText: PAN PAN, PAN PAN, PAN PAN, Wuhan Control, CES5325, the left wing was hit by some foreign objects. And the plane has a banking tendency. Request priority landing and emergency services.
cards.referenceTextZh: PAN PAN，PAN PAN，PAN PAN，武汉区调，东方5325，左侧机翼似乎被异物击中，且飞机出现倾斜趋势。请求优先着陆及地面应急服务待命。

cards.audioText: C: CES5325, roger PAN, descend to and maintain 4800m, report over XSH.
cards.audioTextZh: C：东方5325，收到PAN，下4800米保持，过XSH报。
cards.referenceText: Descend to and maintain 4800m, wilco, CES5325.

cards.audioText:
C: CES5325, we’ve notified the other relevant parties, please give us more description about your present situation.
B: [Report to ATC that No.3 engine has flamed out and it is even harder to overcome the banking tendency. You guess there might be more damages to the left wing.]
cards.audioTextZh:
C：东方5325，我们已通知相关单位，请详细描述你目前的状况。
B：【向空管报告：3号发动机已熄火，飞机倾斜趋势加剧，难以改平。推测左侧机翼可能还有更多损伤。】
cards.referenceText: No.3 engine has flamed out and it is even harder to overcome the banking tendency. We suspect there might be some more damages to the left wing, CES5325.
cards.referenceTextZh: 3号发动机已熄火，飞机倾斜趋势加剧，难以改平。我们推测左侧机翼可能还有更多损伤，东方5325。

cards.audioTextZh: C：东方5325，保持联系并随时通报情况。

cards.audioText: C: CES5325, maintain present level and contact Wuhan Approach on 118.9, good day.
cards.audioTextZh: C：东方5325，保持当前高度，联系武汉进近118.9，再见。

cards.audioText: B: [Now you’re over XSH at 4800m, call Wuhan Approach and inform them that you’re in distress now.]
cards.audioTextZh: B：【现在你已经过XSH，高度4800米，联系武汉进近，告知他们你现在遇险了。】
cards.referenceText: Mayday Mayday Mayday, Wuhan Approach, CES5325, we’ve been struck by foreign objects, No.3 engine flame out and the aircraft tends to bank, we are now passing XSH at 4800m.
cards.referenceTextZh: Mayday Mayday Mayday，武汉进近，东方5325，我们被外物损伤，3号发动机熄火，飞机有倾斜趋势，我们现在已经过XSH，高度4800米。

cards.audioText: C: CES5325, roger Mayday, the Center controller has told us your situation, you’ll have the top priority. Descend to 1200m on QNH1018, expect ILS approach runway 36R, you’re No.1.
cards.audioTextZh: C：东方5325，收到Mayday，区调已经告知我们你的情况，你享有优先权。下1200米，修压1018，预计盲降进近跑道36右，你是第一个。
cards.referenceText: Descend to 1200m on QNH1018, expect ILS approach runway 36R, No.1, CES5325.
cards.referenceTextZh: 下1200米，修压1018，预计盲降进近跑道36右，第一个，东方5325。

cards.audioText: B: [Now you want to verify the wind data, ask ATC to give detailed wind information.]
cards.audioTextZh: B：【你现在想证实风的信息。向管制员询问具体的风的信息。】
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Approach, CES5325, request wind information.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉进近，东方5325，请求风的信息。

cards.audioText: C: CES5325, let me see, the latest ATIS shows, wind 310 degrees, at 11m/s, but it’s variable.
cards.audioTextZh: C：东方5325，最新的ATIS显示，风向310度，11米每秒，但是风向风速不定。

cards.audioText: B: [You consider there might be some problems with you landing, so you ask ATC to provide emergency assistance upon your landing.]
cards.audioTextZh: B：【你认为着陆时可能会出现问题，所以，你向管制申请着陆时提供应急协助。】
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Approach, CES5325, request emergency assistance upon landing due to possible landing problems.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉进近，东方5325，由于着陆问题，请求在着陆时提供紧急协助。

cards.audioText: C: CES5325, roger, fire services and ambulance will be ready upon your landing.
cards.audioTextZh: C：东方5325，收到，消防服务和救护车在你着陆时将就位。

cards.audioText: B: [Now you’ve fully established on the ILS runway 36R, call Wuhan Approach.]
cards.audioTextZh: B：【现在你已经完全建立跑道36右的航向道，联系武汉进近。】
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Approach, CES5325, established on the ILS runway 36R.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉进近，东方5325，已经完全建立跑道36右的航向道。

cards.audioText: C: CES5325, continue approach and contact Tower 118.6, good day.
cards.audioTextZh: C：东方5325，继续进近，联系塔台118.6，再见。
cards.referenceText: Continue approach and contact Tower 118.6, CES5325.
cards.referenceTextZh: 继续进近，联系塔台118.6，东方5325。

cards.audioText: B: [Now contact Tower, report to ATC that you are on emergency landing.]
cards.audioTextZh: B：【现在联系塔台，报告管制员，你现在正在进行紧急着陆。】
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, CES5325, we are on emergency landing.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，东方5325，我们正在进行紧急着陆。

cards.audioText: C: CES5325, radar identified, continue ILS approach runway 36R, you’re No.1, report the outer marker.
cards.audioTextZh: C：东方5325，雷达看见了，继续盲降进近跑道36右，你是第一个，外指点标报。
cards.referenceText: Continue ILS approach runway 36R, No.1, wilco, CES5325.
cards.referenceTextZh: 继续盲降进近跑道36右，第一个，照办，东方5325。
